result.detail: File names follow the microarchitecture plan (rr_arbiter.v, rr_arbiter_tb.v). Both files use `timescale 1ns/1ps so that Verilator does not raise TIMESCALEMOD. The RTL restores `default_nettype wire at the end of the file. The testbench drives inputs on the falling edge and checks on the rising edge. Checks begin at the second reset edge, so the unreset X pointer before reset is never compared. A follow-up formal task should still submit one .sby (mode prove, no [tasks]) at N 4 and a second job at N 5, as the microarchitecture plans. It should also add the failure-path testbench. Neither is done here.
